about_the_game:
IT IS HAPPENING AGAIN. DEFRAG. DESTROY. DELIVER.


Sawyer & Tomodachi are Back! After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississipi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence...

Digital Exorcist is a story-rich horror adventure game/visual novel inspired by Japanese adventure classics like Snatcher, Policenauts and The Silver Case.
As a Digital Exorcist, you will first need to investigate and piece together the crime, and then exorcise the demon responsible with a variety of tools.

content_descriptors.notes: A superstar idol falls to her death. Her body doesn't present any severe trauma or dismemberment. There are pools of blood. Suicides are implied but not shown.
